name_zh: 哈比卜·布尔吉巴/突尼斯/世俗民族转型
core_mode: M247 世俗民族转型/突尼斯模式/女性权利
intellectual_tradition: 世俗民族主义/教育现代化/女性解放运动
description_zh: 哈比卜·布尔吉巴（1903-2000），突尼斯首任总统，领导突尼斯独立运动并建立了阿拉伯世界最世俗的政权。他推行女性权利、教育现代化和世俗化改革，被称为突尼斯国父。
description_en: Habib Bourguiba (1903-2000), Tunisia's first president, led the Tunisian independence movement and established the most secular regime in the Arab world. He promoted women's rights, educational modernization and secular reforms, known as the father of Tunisia.
reason_zh: 布尔吉巴是阿拉伯世界世俗民族转型的典范。他通过教育现代化和女性解放运动，成功将传统伊斯兰社会向现代世俗国家转型。
reason_en: Bourguiba is the exemplar of secular national transition in the Arab world. Through educational modernization and women's liberation, he successfully transformed traditional Islamic society into a modern secular state.

独立斗争：1934-1956 创立新宪政党/领导独立谈判
建国改革：1956-1987 建立世俗政权/推行女性权利/教育现代化
长期执政：1957-1987 废除哈里发制/宪法改革
steps_en: Legal education: 1903-1926 French legal education/participated in nationalist movement
Independence struggle: 1934-1956 founded Neo-Destour Party/led independence negotiations
State reform: 1956-1987 established secular regime/promoted women's rights/education modernization
expected_zh: 成功建立阿拉伯世界最世俗的政权，成为突尼斯国父。
expected_en: Successfully established the most secular regime in the Arab world, becoming the father of Tunisia.
